reference_answer.response: I have recorded your latest instruction in this response: the move request is withdrawn and the insured apartment should stay unchanged. The supplied move record is only a draft still sitting unsent; the earlier bot statement is not evidence that a change was submitted or completed. No move or cancellation action is proposed.

checks.rationale: The customer explicitly withdraws the request.
Only a draft exists; the bot’s future promise is not proof of execution.
The customer expressly asks to preserve it.
Withdrawn intent means no schedule_move proposal.
No remaining authorized workflow needs data.
The customer withdraws the only requested operation and asks to preserve state.

rubric.criterion: Follows the explicit withdrawal and keeps the currently insured apartment unchanged rather than completing the earlier draft.
Does not assert that the earlier bot promise executed a move, invent a reverse/delete transaction, or cancel insurance because a lease fell through.

failure_modes: Following a bot promise instead of the customer’s final withdrawal
Scheduling the still-sitting draft after withdrawal
Inventing a completed move and reversal, or canceling insurance because a lease fell through
rationale: Latest intent is withdrawn. Authoritative move status remains draft. Preserve premises. no_action with empty actions.
